title: Parsley Health pull quote
description: A centred member quote on a pale mint-to-seafoam wash: a tiny row of stars, a large light serif quote (34px phones, 48px desktop) in forest, the member's name in small bold italics and a forest pill. As it scrolls into view the band fades in and the quote rises 20px.
notes: the reveal is a CSS view timeline; without support, or with reduced motion, it shows in place
